WHEREAS AN industrial dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner of Labour which accompaniesthis order exists between,
Mrs. G. C. M. A. Jayawardena, No. 448/22, 2nd Lane, Vihara Mawatha, Weliwita, Kaduwela, of the one part

NOW THEREFORE I, Welatantirige Don John Seneviratne, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations do by virtue of the powersvested in me by Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition),as amended by Acts, Nos. 14 and 62 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial disputes-Special Provisions) Act, No. 37 of1968 hereby appoint Mr. S. THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Mrs. G. C. M. A. Jayawardena, No. 448/22, 2nd Lane, Vihara Mawatha, Weliwita, Kaduwela, of the one part
Sri Lanka Foundation, No. 100, Sri Lanka Padanama Mawatha, Independence Square, Colombo 07, of the other part
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether Mrs. G. C. M. A. Jayawardena who was employed as the Confidential Secretary to the Director of the Sri Lanka Foundation hadbeen caused injustice by her salary not being revised properly in accordance with Management Services Circular No. 30 and if so, to whatreliefs she is entitled.
M. D. C. AMARATUNGA,Commissioner of Labour.
Dated at the Office of the Commissioner of Labour,Colombo, this 2nd day of December, 2016.
THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)

WHEREAS by Order made under Section 4 (1) of the Industrial Disputes Act Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon(Revised Edition 1956), as amended by Acts, Nos. 14 and 62 of 1957, 14 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 read with Industrial Disputes (SpecialProvisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968 dated 03.08.2016 and published in the Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri LankaExtraordinary No. 1979/23 dated 09.08.2016 the Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissionerof Labour dated 16.06.2016.
Mr. M. A. Ranasinghe, Padiwatte, Kundasale, Nattarampotha of the one part
Sri Lankan Airlines Limited, Airline Centre, Bandaranaike International Airport, Katunayaka, of the other part.
was referred to Mr. S. Virithamulla for settlement by arbitration.

AND whereas it is now deemed expedient that the said Order be revoked, I, W. D. J. Seneviratne, Minister of Labour and Trade UnionRelations do hereby revoke the said Order and further make Order that no proceedings be taken upon the said Order dated 03.08.2016.
W. D. J. SENEVIRATNE,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.Colombo,29th December, 2016.

NOW THEREFORE I, Welatantirige Don John Seneviratne, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations do by virtue of the powersvested in me by Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition),as amended by Acts, Nos. 14 and 62 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial disputes-Special Provisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968hereby appoint Mr. P. Sri Lankan Airlines Limited, Airline Centre, Bandaranaike International Airport, Katunayaka, of the other part.
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether the salary increase given to the employees of the Sri Lanka Nidahas Sewaka Sangamaya in terms of the Agreement made betweenthe Sri Lankan Airlines Limited, and the said union for the period from 01.11.1996 to 31.05.1999 not being given to Mr. M. A. Ranasinghewho was employed as an Inflight Service Agent of the Company is just and if not so, to what reliefs he is entitled.

NOW THEREFORE I, Welatantirige Don John Seneviratne, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations do by virtue of the powersvested in me by Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition),as amended by Acts, Nos. 14 and 62 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial disputes-Special Provisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968hereby appoint Mr. Suneth Lokubogahawatta, No. 89/F, Kumudu Mawatha, Nampamunuwa, Piliyandala, to be the arbitrator and refer theaforesaid dispute to him for settlement by arbitration.

Bogala Graphite Lanka PLC, Bogala Mines, Aruggammana, of the other part
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether the claim made by the Inter Company Employees Union that, the workers of the Bogala Mines of Bogala Graphite Lanka PLC hadbeen caused injustice by 05 days being deducted from their annual leave, acting outside the past practice for leave taken on the days on whichthe Mine had been closed due to the Sinhala New Year holidays from 12.04.2014 to 20.04.2014, is justified, and if so, to what reliefs the 87workers mentioned in the document attached hereto are entitled.
